description: TASK-01: Initialize Go workspace (go.work), root go.mod, and Docker Compose (PostgreSQL 16 + Keycloak)

annotations.description: Initialize root go.mod (attendance_mangement) with github.com/gin-gonic/gin, github.com/jackc/pgx/v5, github.com/pressly/goose/v3, golang.org/x/oauth2, github.com/caarlos0/env/v11, github.com/stretchr/testify, github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go, and go.uber.org/mock. Create go.work and docker-compose.yml with postgres:16-alpine and Keycloak importing infra/keycloak/realm-attendance.json (confidential backend client with Direct Access Grants + Service Account enabled, roles: ORG_ADMIN, EMPLOYEE, GATE_KIOSK).

description: TASK-02: Implement typed environment configuration loader in pkg/config/env.go using caarlos0/env

annotations.description: Create pkg/config/env.go defining Config struct parsed via caarlos0/env/v11: HTTPPort (default 8080), DatabaseURL (required), KeycloakIssuerURL (required), KeycloakClientID (required), KeycloakClientSecret (required), LogLevel (default info), and EnabledModules ([]string, envSeparator:","). Write unit tests in pkg/config/env_test.go.

description: TASK-03: Implement generic Gin request/response helpers (BindJSON[T], JSON, RFC 7807 Error) in pkg/httpx/response.go

annotations.description: Create pkg/httpx/response.go with generic BindJSON[T any](c *gin.Context) (T, bool) that binds JSON and aborts with standardized RFC 7807 ProblemDetails JSON (status 400) on validation failure, plus JSON(c, status, data) and Error(c, status, code, detail) helpers. Verify with gin.CreateTestContext unit tests.

description: TASK-04: Implement Keycloak JWKS verification middleware, RequireRole, and headless OAuth2 token proxy handlers in pkg/httpx/

annotations.description: Create pkg/httpx/middleware.go verifying RS256 JWT signatures locally via cached Keycloak JWKS keys ({KEYCLOAK_ISSUER}/protocol/openid-connect/certs), extracting sub, org_id, and roles into gin.Context, plus RequireRole(...) and SlogLogger. Create pkg/httpx/auth_proxy.go exposing headless POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/refresh, and POST /api/auth/logout via golang.org/x/oauth2 against Keycloak's token endpoints. Test with httptest mock Keycloak server.

description: TASK-05: Implement pgxpool connector, TenantTx isolation helper, and schema-scoped goose migration runner in pkg/db/

annotations.description: Create pkg/db/postgres.go with Connect(ctx, databaseURL) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) and RunModuleMigrations(ctx, pool, schema, embed.FS) configuring pressly/goose/v3 with per-schema version table (<schema>.goose_db_version). Create pkg/db/tenant_tx.go enforcing non-empty tenantID on transactional queries.

description: TASK-06: Implement thread-safe in-memory Pub/Sub EventBus in pkg/events/bus.go

annotations.description: Create pkg/events/bus.go defining Event (Topic, TenantID, Payload []byte), HandlerFunc, Bus interface (Publish, Subscribe), and thread-safe RWMutex-backed InMemoryBus. Write unit tests verifying concurrent publish/subscribe delivery and panic isolation.

description: TASK-07: Build pkg/app module registry, selective ResolveModules filter, Gin server builder, and cmd/server/main.go

annotations.description: Create pkg/app/module.go (CoreContext, FeatureModule interface, Register(), ResolveModules(requested []string)) and pkg/app/server.go (gin.New(), unauthenticated /healthz and /api/auth/* routes, JWT-protected /api/<module.Name()> RouterGroups, graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown). Create cmd/server/main.go parsing -modules CLI flag (defaulting to all modules when empty).

description: TASK-08: Create modules/organization child Go module, schema `org` goose migrations, and domain types

annotations.description: Initialize modules/organization/go.mod (attendance_mangement/modules/organization) and register in go.work. Write embedded migrations/001_init.sql creating schema `org`, `org.policies` (tenant_id, allowed_methods TEXT[], salary_slip_enabled BOOLEAN, shift_start_time, shift_end_time), and `org.employees` (id, tenant_id, keycloak_sub, full_name, email, biometric_ref_id, is_active).

description: TASK-09: Implement modules/organization pgxpool repo, Keycloak Admin user provisioning, policy service, and Gin handlers

annotations.description: Implement pgxpool queries scoped by tenant_id in modules/organization/repository.go. Implement Keycloak Admin REST client (using golang.org/x/oauth2/clientcredentials) to provision users and assign roles headlessly on POST /employees. Implement PolicyService validating punch methods (FACESCAN_KIOSK, FINGERSCAN_KIOSK, WEB_LOGIN, MOBILE_LOGIN), publishing 'org.policy.updated', and mounting Gin routes GET/PUT /policy and GET/POST /employees.

description: TASK-10: Create modules/attendance child Go module, schema `attendance` goose migrations, and domain structs

annotations.description: Initialize modules/attendance/go.mod (attendance_mangement/modules/attendance) and add to go.work. Write embedded migrations/001_init.sql creating schema `attendance`, `attendance.logs` (id, tenant_id, employee_sub, punch_type IN/OUT, punch_method, punched_at, kiosk_device_id, metadata JSONB), `attendance.paired_sessions` (id, tenant_id, employee_sub, punch_in_at, punch_out_at, duration_minutes), and `attendance.tenant_policies`.

description: TASK-11: Implement modules/attendance punch-in/out pairing repository and business logic service

annotations.description: Implement transactional punch-in/out repository in modules/attendance/repository.go (preventing duplicate IN without OUT, rejecting OUT without open IN, computing duration_minutes on OUT). Subscribe to 'org.policy.updated' to sync local tenant_policies table without cross-schema joins. Publish 'attendance.session.completed' event on PUNCH_OUT.

description: TASK-12: Implement modules/attendance Gin HTTP handlers (/punch, /me, /reports) and Testcontainers/mock test suite

annotations.description: Implement Gin handlers in modules/attendance/module.go: POST /punch (EMPLOYEE or GATE_KIOSK), GET /me (EMPLOYEE), and GET /reports (ORG_ADMIN date-range summary). Generate mocks with uber-go/mock, write httptest handler tests, and write testcontainers-go Postgres integration tests verifying tenant isolation.

description: TASK-13: Create modules/payroll child Go module and schema `payroll` goose migrations

annotations.description: Initialize modules/payroll/go.mod (attendance_mangement/modules/payroll) and register in go.work. Write embedded migrations/001_init.sql creating schema `payroll`, `payroll.tenant_settings` (tenant_id, salary_slip_enabled), `payroll.salary_structures` (tenant_id, employee_sub, base_monthly_cents, currency), `payroll.attendance_tallies`, and `payroll.salary_slips`.

description: TASK-14: Implement modules/payroll salary slip calculation service, event listeners, and Gin handlers

annotations.description: Subscribe to 'org.policy.updated' and 'attendance.session.completed' in modules/payroll to track payable days locally. Implement SalarySlipService calculating prorated pay and rejecting generation if salary_slip_enabled is false. Mount Gin routes POST /slips/generate (ORG_ADMIN), GET /slips/me (EMPLOYEE), and GET /slips (ORG_ADMIN).

description: TASK-15: Scaffold Angular workspace with Angular Material UI theme and shell navigation

annotations.description: Initialize Angular standalone app in frontend-web/ and install @angular/material. Configure Material 3 theme, MatToolbar, MatSidenav responsive navigation shell, and shared notification service using MatSnackBar.

description: TASK-16: Build Angular native Material login screen, headless /api/auth/* token service, and role guards

annotations.description: Build native Angular Material Login component (MatCard, MatFormField, MatInput) posting credentials to Go backend POST /api/auth/login (zero browser redirects to Keycloak). Implement AuthService with automatic POST /api/auth/refresh, functional Bearer HttpInterceptor, and RoleGuard checking ORG_ADMIN vs EMPLOYEE claims.

description: TASK-17: Build Angular Employee Portal (web punch-in/out button, attendance history MatTable, and salary slips)

annotations.description: Build Employee Dashboard component in frontend-web/src/app/features/employee-portal/: fetch org policy to enable/disable Web Punch In/Out button (WEB_LOGIN), render personal punch-in/out sessions in MatTable with MatPaginator, and display monthly salary slips when enabled.

description: TASK-18: Build Angular Org Admin Portal (punch method toggles, attendance report builder, and payroll generator)

annotations.description: Build Org Admin views in frontend-web/src/app/features/org-admin/: MatSlideToggle controls for FACESCAN_KIOSK, FINGERSCAN_KIOSK, WEB_LOGIN, MOBILE_LOGIN, and salary_slip_enabled; MatDatepicker range filter for org-wide attendance reports with CSV download; and conditional monthly salary slip batch generator.

description: TASK-19: Scaffold Flutter project with Material 3 theme, typed API client, and environment config

annotations.description: Initialize Flutter project in mobile-flutter/ configured with Material 3 (ThemeData(useMaterial3: true)), compile-time --dart-define environment config (API_BASE_URL), and typed REST API client layer.

description: TASK-20: Build Flutter native Material 3 login screen, headless /api/auth/* token client, and role router

annotations.description: Build native Material 3 Login screen in mobile-flutter/lib/core/auth/ calling Go backend POST /api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh (no webview/browser redirect to Keycloak), storing tokens in flutter_secure_storage, and routing GATE_KIOSK role sessions to GateKioskShell and EMPLOYEE sessions to EmployeeShell.

description: TASK-21: Build Flutter Personal Employee screens (mobile punch-in/out, log history, and salary slip viewer)

annotations.description: Implement Material 3 EmployeeShell with NavigationBar tabs in mobile-flutter/lib/features/employee/: Home Punch Card (checking MOBILE_LOGIN policy before enabling Punch In/Out), Attendance History list showing paired IN/OUT timestamps, and Salary Slip viewer.

description: TASK-22: Build Flutter Gate Kiosk FaceScan attendance workflow

annotations.description: Build Gate Kiosk FaceScan mode in mobile-flutter/lib/features/gate_kiosk/: verify FACESCAN_KIOSK is enabled in org policy, initialize front camera preview overlay, capture employee biometric/face identifier + IN/OUT toggle, post to /api/attendance/punch with kiosk_device_id, and auto-reset screen after 3 seconds.

description: TASK-23: Build Flutter Gate Kiosk FingerScan attendance workflow

annotations.description: Build Gate Kiosk FingerScan mode in mobile-flutter/lib/features/gate_kiosk/: verify FINGERSCAN_KIOSK is enabled in org policy, integrate local_auth / external USB-Bluetooth fingerprint scanner abstraction, submit verified employee biometric ID + IN/OUT punch to /api/attendance/punch, and show Material 3 confirmation banner.

description: TASK-24: End-to-end verification across cmd/server (-modules modes), headless Keycloak auth, Angular Material, and Flutter clients

annotations.description: Verify full system: boot docker-compose (Postgres + Keycloak), verify headless /api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh flow, test cmd/server with no flags (all modules) and with -modules=attendance, run go test -race ./..., run ng build in frontend-web/, and run flutter analyze && flutter test in mobile-flutter/.
